notes: TBox all-fictional insert. 'Can it be an Ashby polygon?' is mode consistent.

fol.notes: The edit's 'some Quellan circle' is a Skolem function circle_of (local). The find counts the different circles the three polygons are bound to; that this is the least number of Quellan circles is because a model with no other circles exists (the count is entailed, so no fewer is possible).

local.circle_of: Skolem function of the edit: the Quellan circle a given Ashby polygon is merrow-bound to

one_polygon_per_circle.says: No circle has more than one polygon merrow-bound to it.
one_polygon_per_circle.z3: ForAll([p, q, k], Implies(And(merrow_bound(p, k), merrow_bound(q, k)), p == q))

three_polygons.says: Three different Ashby polygons are drawn.

queries.find: 1 + If(circle_of(p2) != circle_of(p1), 1, 0) + If(And(circle_of(p3) != circle_of(p1), circle_of(p3) != circle_of(p2)), 1, 0)
